question.text: A series LCR circuit with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>L</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>100</mn><mi>π</mi></mfrac><mo> </mo><mi>mH</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mi>π</mi></mfrac><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>, is connected across an AC source of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>220</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>,</mo><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Hz</mi></math> supply. The power factor of the circuit would be ____.

solution.text:
The capacitive reactance of the circuit is given by, 

Xc=1ωC=π2π×50×10-3=10 Ω

The inductive reactance of the circuit is given by, 

XL=ωL=2π×50×100π×10-3=10 Ω

From above calculations, it is clear that

XC=XL

∴ Power factor =RZ=RR=1
